info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Kestrel Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Kestrel Battery Detail Management API facilitates the creation and submission of battery details within the product catalog. This API endpoint enables businesses to effectively manage specifications, features, and pricing information for Kestrel batteries. It primarily serves manufacturers and retailers looking to maintain accurate product listings and improve inventory management. Users can integrate this API into their systems to streamline the onboarding of battery specifications into their catalogs, ensuring that customers have access to the latest product information.

post.summary: Create or update details for a Kestrel battery.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create or update details pertaining to a Kestrel battery. This action ensures that the battery information is up-to-date and accurately reflects the current state of the battery.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details necessary to perform an operation on the Kestrel battery. Ensure that all required fields are correctly filled to guarantee a successful operation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the resource details are returned.

kestrel_battery_id.description: Unique identifier for the Kestrel battery.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of Kestrel batteries involved in the operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the operation is of priority status.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Kestrel battery.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Kestrel battery.

supplier.description: Information about the supplier of the Kestrel batteries.
